owner_calls.question: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#103's flashback entry has sub "Flashback", but the owner's rule gives a flashback a year as its sub. The episode puts it "28 years ago" (Wikipedia; the season's present is 2018) and Fandom says "the 1990s". Change the sub to a year?
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's Rise and Shine summary: '28 years ago, a young Hale was assigned by Daniel Whitehall...'. Fandom: 'In a flashback set in the 1990s, young Hale wakes up for her last day at the Hydra Preparatory Academy... students led by von Strucker make a prank on her. Infuriated, Hale attacks Strucker.' The event itself checks out.
